title: nephrolepis gibbosa
intro: Nephrolepis gibbosa, commonly known as the Lady Palm or Lady's Palm, is a species of flowering plant in the family Polypodiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Nephrolepis gibbosa are attributed to its ability to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in soothing skin irritations and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
